visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a large, intricate red paper-cut Goshuin shaped like a maple leaf with a gold deer silhouette against a traditional Japanese temple background with ornate wooden carvings. (2) The hand displays a blue paper-cut Goshuin depicting a temple building and coastal mountains under a clear blue sky. (3) The camera pans across a counter in a temple shop filled with numerous colorful Japanese amulets (omamori) in various patterns and boxes. (4) A close-up shows a hand picking up a black amulet with red floral designs, followed by a display of 'Mamori-Suna' (amulet sand) in small bottles and white sachets on a dedicated stand. (5) A hand holds a small Daruma doll figurine, then shows rows of small orange ceramic deer figurines used for fortunes (omikuji). (6) The scene shifts to the exterior of the Daisho-in temple, showing the large wooden Nio-mon gate with statues and a large hanging bronze bell surrounded by lush green trees. (7) A view from a high vantage point overlooks a blue bay with a ferry and distant mountains. (8) The camera pans across golden prayer wheels along a stone staircase, ending on a small stone statue wearing a red knitted hat.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 宮島限定. [Variety]: 超精緻紙雕御朱印！. (2) [Variety]: 不只精美御朱印 御守種類也超多.. (3) [Variety]: 還有超特別的祈願守護砂！ (4) [Variety]: 達摩御籤跟小鹿御籤也都很可愛 (5) [Subtitle]: 這裡是位在廣島縣宮島上的大聖院. (6) [Subtitle]: 座落於山林之中，環境十分清幽. (7) [Subtitle]: 從高處往下看還能俯瞰到海景！ (8) [Subtitle]: 沿途可以看到多個轉經輪. [Variety]: 據說只需轉輪即可獲讀經功德喔. (9) [Slogan]: 喜歡收集御朱印的人 一定要去！
